fieldFrame: uint32_le(UTF-8 field-name length) + UTF-8 field name + uint8(typeTag) + uint64_le(payload length) + payload
textPolicy: case-sensitive UTF-8 with no locale conversion or implicit normalisation
vectorPolicy: original order; IEEE 754 float32 bits; little-endian
signedZeroPolicy: +0 and -0 tie for ranking and remain distinct in the digest
digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over the complete framed stream
filterPolicy: filters are ordinally sorted sets digested with the same framing
rankedFieldNamePolicy: field names repeat by rank with an eight-digit decimal index
reproducibilityPlan: two consecutive same-process executions plus one cold-start execution, RB-4 only
